outcome: For one authentication-evidence reference, route identity, and injected decision time, return every matching server-owned authentication record and route binding in deterministic order, marking only current non-revoked evidence and enabled complete route bindings as admissible inputs; any provider failure supplies no authority and the authorization service returns DENY.
scope: One storage-neutral trusted-input resolution capability, one provider-neutral persistence binding, and one local SQLite realization composed in process with the existing trusted command boundary and authorization decision service.
exclusions: token parsing, issuance, refresh, or revocation protocol
caller-supplied session, permission, scope, trust, or currentness authority
HTTP, audit transport, deployment, multi-node, and production-security claims

revision_history.change: Proposed concrete SQLite resolvers for the two remaining trusted command-boundary ports and one in-process service composition.
Separated storage-neutral product meaning from the provider-neutral persistence binding and generated typed Query realization.

challenge_route: Challenge trusted-input meaning through the Auth Foundation definition owner, storage correspondence through the Rust implementation owner, and route requirements through the protected route owner.
claim_limit: Candidate Product Capability; local validation cannot grant definition admission, capability adoption, ontology admission, publication, deployment, or production authority.
